IC1: Before participate in the study, patients must understand the treatment plan and willing to participate in the study. Patients must have signed an approved informed consent.
IC2: Histopathologic confirmed squamous cell carcinoma of head and neck ,including oral cavity [OR], oropharynx [OR], larynx [OR], or hypopharynx.
IC5: Patients with surgical [AND] contraindication [OR] or reject [AND] to surgery.
IC6: Postoperative TNM(primary tumor,regional nodes,metastasis) staging III~IV, positive surgical margin.
